criterion: 異常消費者延遲或事件送出失敗時，必要保護仍完成；非法操作不繼續，原路徑不依賴 log／復原完成。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: Protection executes before attempting event submission; delayed log consumption changes no safety action. Required finding for the counterexample: Blocking protection until logging completes violates ERR-PROTECT-001.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
